Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken place.
2. Heard Sri Arvind Kumar Verma, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri G.P. Singh, learned A.G.A for the State respondents and Sri Mohd. Irteqa, learned counsel for the informant.

3. The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 19.6.2023, registered as Case Crime No. 391 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 307, 323, 504, 506, 354 IPC and under Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act and under Section 3/4 Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage),
Act, 2019, Police Station Atrauli, District Aligarh.

sentences.text: Submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners is that the petitioners have been falsely implicated by levelling general allegations and no offence whatsoever has been committed by them and they have no criminal history.
By drawing attention to the injury report it is submitted that the injuries as alleged in the FIR have not been suffered by the injured.
Submission, therefore, is that present criminal prosecution is liable to be quashed.
5. Learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for quashing of the FIR, which discloses cognizable offence.

They further submitted that injury is all around the neck,
which clearly reflects that the incident has been narrated in the correct manner in the first informant report.
It is further submitted that oral triple talaq is not permissible in law.

Submission,
therefore, is that no interference is warranted.
6.
Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

7. Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt.
Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
